verdict.rationale: Runway Dev offers a first-party HTTP API for its generative models, so automation can run without the browser UI. The docs describe an asynchronous submit-then-poll flow (`GET /v1/tasks/{id}`), cURL usage, and a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, which a probe confirmed is live. That covers the core of running the product headlessly in scripts or pipelines. Missing for 10: CI-specific guidance (e.g., API-key handling in CI or pipeline examples), a dedicated CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
